note: The institutional risk mandate the calibration candidate is judged against. These were five string literals reading "explicitly_unset" inside src/calibration_candidate.py, with a rejection rule whose only trigger was the fact that they were unset — so final approval was blocked by a condition the code made impossible to satisfy. They are parameters now: edit this file to change the mandate, no code change. A limit left null is reported as unset (honestly, and it still blocks); a limit that is set but that the current evidence cannot measure is reported as not evaluable, which is a fact about coverage, not a verdict. Both open by themselves when the input changes.

daily_cvar_95.description: Maximum 95% daily conditional value at risk.

beta.description: Maximum absolute beta to the reference benchmark.

max_drawdown.description: Maximum peak-to-trough drawdown over the evaluation window.

turnover.description: Maximum turnover per rebalance. Measured today by the candidate generator's turnover proxy (L1 distance from the baseline weights).

exposure_bounds.description: Maximum gross exposure. Unlevered long-only mandate.
